akṛtayūṣaḥ अकृतयूषः
Non-processed soup of vegetables
A type of food preparation in which a soup of vegetables and/or pulses is prepared by adding 16 parts water without processing with oil or ghee, and spices.

ITA-9.7.12 akṛtrimaviṣam अकृत्रिमविषम्
Poison of natural origin
A poison from a natural source or unmodified natural poison.
